about: Docs/Design/84 §15.3: the talk scorecard (tools/talk_score.py), from talk_sim transcripts.

R4.name: distinctive line heard again within 10 h, per 100 h

R7.name: distinct reply entries per 1,000 reply beats

R8.name: habit saturation (% of a speaker's lines, mean)

C1Q.name: questions answered: the '?' heuristic (%)
C1Q.target: diagnostic (C1 until Phase 3; doesn't separate from the control)

C2.name: replies at the best fit available (%)

C3.name: endings by a farewell or a marked break (%)

C6.name: same entry or question twice in a conversation, per 1,000

T3.name: self-reference errors (own name, the listener in the third person, unbacked eyewitness words), per 1,000 lines

T4.name: identity drift: a stance changed with no event or concede, or answered against one's own, per 1,000 stance lines

T6.name: 'they' said of one known wolf named in the line, per 1,000 lines

D1A.name: lines said a step broader or plainer than the speaker's own accent (%)

T5.name: telling what the listener already believes, with no 'known' answer (%)

D1.name: lines with a dialect's words (%): accent none

D1L.name: lines with a dialect's words (%): light speakers

D1B.name: lines with a dialect's words (%): broad speakers

D2.name: another dialect's words in a speaker's line

D3.name: dialect guessed from 20 lines (%): light and broad

U1.name: a resident's lines from their own words (%)

K3.name: same news told twice to the same resident

W3.name: a resident answers chat with the option off

X1.name: lexical cohesion: replies sharing a content word with the line before (%)
X1.target: diagnostic (not in §15.3): shows the control is discriminating

examples: rm_edmund_sootdale: Can't keep away, then. Another bad business. It never stops. A light-pawed sort took Rupert Fogton's things. They'll be disappointed.
Good evening, little one. Agnes Wetley tried to steal from Ebba Slagstack, they say. / rmx_ebba_netherby: Who's they?

Back so soon? More trouble. We were on about it only lately. They say Rika Gullwell did Dagny Slaghand. We've had Rika Gullwell at our fire. / rm_josephine_brineford: I counted the spoons after they left. Never told you.
Again! We'd only just finished with the last of this. I keep my purse inside my coat since Rupert Fogton. / rm_cressida_tarham: Inside the coat's where they look first.
That's not the only tale going. Osric Ropeworth is wanted by the Watch for attempted theft. Best not be seen with him. / rm_imogen_ashby: Have they a notice up?
And it'll do nothing for prices. Karin Sootdale gave me short weight again. I'm sure of it. / rmx_philippa_coldby: They're all the same, shopkeepers. Thumb on the scale.
Prices again. It's all anyone talks of. Went to Tove Brinegate's for candles. Came out with soap. Don't ask. / rmx_ilse_netherby: They're all the same, shopkeepers. Thumb on the scale.
tn_oh_varg_acorndell: Jory Rimepeak's family are coming for the festival. All of them.
Jory Rimepeak's family are coming for the festival. All of them. / tn_cw_fallow_lakewick: In-laws. Like weather. You wait them out.
My belly's been talking to me all morning. Jory Rimepeak hides the honey from me. I always find it. / tn_cw_fallow_lakewick: They'll keep you young. Or old. One of the two.
Jory Rimepeak snores like a mill. / tn_cw_fallow_lakewick: They'll keep you young. Or old. One of the two.
Good day. Good to see you in. You look tired, Gunnar Farrow. / rmx_gunnar_farrow: The knees complain, but they still carry me.
